identity.name: VVIP Infratech Limited
identity.industry: Water & Sewage Infrastructure & Urban Real Estate Development

summary.oneLiner: EPC revenue grew 29% YoY with EBITDA margin expanding to 14% and consolidated PAT margin jumped to 9.7% due to scale and efficiency; real estate land bank expanded by 40,000 sqm with two new projects worth Rs. 1.7-1.8B, setting up multi-year revenue visibility and margin uplift

one-line thesis: EPC revenue grew 29% YoY with EBITDA margin expanding to 14% and consolidated PAT margin jumped to 9.7% due to scale and efficiency; real estate land bank expanded by 40,000 sqm with two new projects worth Rs. 1.7-1.8B, setting up multi-year revenue visibility and margin uplift
financial scorecard: revenue: Rs. 373cr (+30% YoY); EBITDA/margin: Rs. 78cr (+154% YoY), 21% margin; PAT (rptd): Rs. 36cr (+80% YoY); PAT (normalized): Rs. 36cr (no major distortions); order book: Rs. 869cr (STP: Rs. 335cr, RDSS: Rs. 326cr, Jal Jeevan: Rs. 208cr); net debt: Rs. 35cr fund-based + Rs. 75cr non-fund-based limit, no material net debt increase
guidance: revenue growth: 40% CAGR target for EPC; margin: 15-17% sustainable for EPC, 20-25% for real estate; order inflow: Rs. 448cr pipeline; capex/commissioning: Rs. 900cr in-house capex for real estate projects over next 3-4 years
order book & pipeline: Rs. 869cr total: STP Rs. 335cr (39%); RDSS Rs. 326cr (37%); Jal Jeevan Mission Rs. 208cr (24%)
segment / subsidiary detail: EPC: STP (up to 56MLD), RDSS (33kV substations, feeders), Jal Jeevan (rural water networks); Real Estate: 75L sqft delivered in NCR; 2 active projects: VVIP Namah (6.21L sqft, Rs. 500cr revenue), VVIP Addresses (12L sqft, Rs. 900cr revenue share); 2 new land acquisitions: Yamuna Expressway (25 acres, Rs. 800cr+ revenue), Greater Noida West (12L sqft, already launched)
growth verticals / optionality: Expansion into Delhi STP projects (Rs. 400cr pipeline), NBCC/CPWD government building tenders, potential entry into Madhya Pradesh and Rajasthan
margins & cost dynamics: EPC: 15-17% sustainable (up from 14% in FY25); Real Estate: 20-25% EBITDA margin; consolidated blended margin 17-18%; cost efficiencies from scale, procurement, and in-house construction
capex / expansion: Rs. 900cr total construction capex for real estate projects: VVIP Namah (Rs. 100cr remaining), VVIP Addresses (Rs. 450cr), Yamuna Expressway (Rs. 350cr); no external capex planned for EPC
capital allocation: Prioritizing internal cash flow for real estate construction; no immediate fundraising planned; potential debt increase up to 1:1 debt-equity ratio if needed; focus on bank guarantees and mobilization advances
risks & watch-items: Real estate revenue recognition delays due to RERA/completion timelines; execution risk on Rs. 869cr EPC order book; dependency on government payment cycles (though now resolved); land acquisition delays
management quality / tone: Highly confident, aggressive, and disciplined; committed to quarterly disclosures; focused on execution speed, margin discipline, and land bank monetization; no inventory retention policy in real estate
non-obvious takeaways: EPC construction for real estate projects (Rs. 900cr) is fully in-house — meaning EPC revenue from real estate is not outsourced and fully captured in group P&L, creating a hidden revenue stream
